_: THE HARNESS AIMED AT ITSELF — run it from this crate's directory:
Every property this tool holds is a property its own suite claims to hold,
and a claim nobody has broken is a claim nobody has measured. So each
injection here removes ONE of them and names the tests that must go red.
A green run of this file says the suite is not vacuous; a `did not reach`
says a test passes for a reason other than the one it is written for.
Keep it runnable: the `from` texts are exact, and a source edit that moves
one of them makes this sweep refuse out loud rather than pass quietly.

injections.name: the-supervisor-stops-dying-with-the-harness
injections.why: PR_SET_PDEATHSIG is the only notification a SIGKILLed parent can arrange in advance; without it nothing under a killed sweep is told to stop

injections.name: nothing-leads-its-own-process-group
injections.why: one kill must reach every test binary the suite spawned, not only the cargo that spawned them; without a group of its own there is nothing to signal

injections.name: the-supervisor-stops-putting-the-tree-back
injections.why: the originals are on disk precisely so a process the harness cannot reach can restore them; with the restore gone a killed sweep leaves its injection in the tree

injections.name: the-exit-code-goes-back-to-being-recorded-only
injections.why: the status a suite exited with and the names its log listed are each blind where the other sees; recorded side by side and never compared, the pair is worth the weaker of the two

injections.name: the-sweep-supervises-from-a-path-instead-of-its-own-copy
injections.why: the first self-check ever run died here: the suite rebuilt this binary, /proc/self/exe named a deleted file, and the second injection could not be started at all

injections.name: the-manifest-paths-stay-relative-to-wherever-they-were-read
injections.why: the suite runs with the TREE as its working directory, so a relative log path resolves somewhere else the moment it is handed across — the first real sweep under a supervisor died of exactly this

injections.name: a-tree-somebody-else-injected-is-taken-as-a-baseline
injections.why: a sweep that starts on a tree still holding a dead sweep's injection measures that injection as the state everything is compared against
